scope: Eritrea medical discovery — Orotta College of Medicine and Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: Eritrea's Ministry of Information reported that Orotta College of Medicine and Health Sciences held its fourth annual commencement in July 2025 and graduated students across postgraduate, first-degree and diploma qualifications. The report describes active academic support from 90 faculty members during that academic year.
The Eritrean Ministry of Information's 2024 commencement report states that Orotta conferred Doctor of Medicine qualifications among its graduates, alongside postgraduate, degree and diploma awards.

Eritrea's 2022–2026 health-sector strategic plan identifies Orotta Medical School as producing 30–40 doctors annually. This is national-planning context, not a current admissions or capacity guarantee.
